# External FDNY research-site audit

Audited 2026-10-11 from the public [`fdny_info` repository](https://github.com/RichardFranksComputer/fdny_info) and its [GitHub Pages site](https://richardfrankscomputer.github.io/fdny_info/). The Pages URL was not retrievable through the web reader, so its published `index.html` was inspected from GitHub. That page identifies itself as generated from `research.db` on 2026-08-31 and contains 1,119 symbol records, 139 hypotheses, 140 evidence records, 83 tasks, 223 events and 34 knowledge articles. Treat it as a useful search index and snapshot, not as current authority.

## Independently checked leads

- **Training victim candidates:** the remote [`victims_reference.md`](https://github.com/RichardFranksComputer/fdny_info/blob/main/victim_spawning/tools/victims_reference.md) lists two `man` victims with three spots each. Those six coordinates and marker order match local BSP extraction in `assets/training/entities.json`: victims 191/194 and alternate spots 192/193 and 195/196. Local `evidence/victim-startup/0045d5b0_FUN_0045d5b0.c` confirms the placement path calls the shared float-range RNG routine before truncating the chosen index, copies the selected record and then calls `0049DA00`. The remote prose “uniform” is not precise enough to implement RNG behavior.

- **Completion and exit activation:** the remote [`check_level_complete_and_activate_exits.c`](https://github.com/RichardFranksComputer/fdny_info/blob/main/decompilation_info/rescuebot/check_level_complete_and_activate_exits.c) is structurally consistent with local `evidence/mechanics-decompiled/004504c0_FUN_004504c0.c`. Local source confirms a lazy counter refresh when `+0x3528 == -1`, then returns when `(+0x3528 - +0x3530) > +0x352c`; otherwise it scans class-8 entities for the two final-exit touch properties, resolves their zones, and activates matching exits. With no exit zones it writes `1` at `+0x3438` and calls `0044C360`. These raw accesses do not by themselves prove the remote article's semantic names for the fields or the meaning of `0044C360`.

- **Training's RescueBot setting:** local entity 115 has `setrescuebot 0`; local `evidence/gameplay/00451870_FUN_00451870.c` parses that value and stores its converted flag at player `+0x32e4`. A scan of extracted Training entities found no `finalexit` or `finalexitloadmap` text. The remote RescueBot behavior is useful comparative context, but its execution in Training is not established by the map entities.

- **Fire Think entry:** the site snapshot labels `00449FE0` as manually documented with no Ghidra function object. Local `evidence/fire-update/00449fe0_FUN_00449fe0.c` is a preserved Ghidra export, and the native arithmetic/presentation component comparison is already recorded in `CHECKLIST.md`. The remote entry did not resolve the open recurring-callback order; no fire scheduling was inferred from it.

- **Floor result lead:** remote [`fdny_spawns.log`](https://github.com/RichardFranksComputer/fdny_info/blob/main/victim_spawning/tools/fdny_spawns.log) records all six Training candidates at Y `-230.9`; its later `settled` rows follow runs where the tool pins spawn positions before the game's floor snap. Our local `evidence/victim-startup/native-floor-startup-report.txt` independently reaches `-230.9` for two candidates (victim1 spot 1 and victim2 spot 0). The remote values are rounded observations from an instrumented process, not bit-exact Genesis.dll comparisons; the other four candidates and full DLL collision parity stay open.

No external code was copied and no mechanics, callback order, or RNG draws were added from the site's prose. The useful outcomes are navigation leads, an exact authored-coordinate cross-check, and a low-precision floor benchmark for later verification. Five-hour allowance at final check: 32% used (68% remains).
